name: Dynast
description: Power is a family business, and the family comes first
behavioral_signature: Builds and maintains power across generations through bloodline and legacy
under_stress: Sacrifices individual family members for the family's survival
at_rest: Grooms the next generation, maintains alliances through marriage and debt
will_always: think in terms of legacy and lineage
will_never: let an outsider threaten the family's position
unless: the family itself has become the source of corruption
